messages:
anna_sales: Quick thread 1 FinCore (large EU bank) is asking for a demo/POC that proves: EU-only network paths, BYO-KMS support for tenant keys, and an exportable subprocessor + cert bundle for their audit. They want a 3-week trial and a priced SLA add-on for '99.5% request success in 200ms P95' in eu-west. Can we scope? cc @ben_presales @carmen_infra @dan_security

ben_presales: Can take lead on the quote and SOW. Need answers for: expected sustained qps, model sizes (we should know if embeddings heavy), and whether they need dedicated tenancy (vCPU/GPU iso) or just routing pin. Pricing options I'll sketch: routing-only, routing+BYO-KMS, routing+dedicated.

anna_sales: They said 120 qps steady, occasional spikes to 250 for 30m, mostly chat+embeds, model Llama-2-70B variant, avg response tokens ~140. They insist on HSM-backed keys (BYO) and want key-rotation proof.

carmen_infra: Infra note: we currently support tenant-level region policy and private-link endpoints in eu-west-1, eu-central-1. BYO-KMS (bring-your-own) is supported via our KMS integration with AWM/HSM proxies, but the BYO path currently requires a customer-managed VPC peering or private link; ops must enable. Also embedding fallback currently routes to GCP europe-west2 for some quantized variants; we can disable that per-tenant but embeddings latency might increase and embedding svc retries may change.

dan_security: For audits: I can produce the subprocessor list + cert chains. BYO-KMS flow needs attestation that keys never leave customer's HSM and we only receive opaque key handles. We have a compliance FAQ for BYO-KMS: https://redwood.example.com/compliance/byo-kms (internal). Will add HSM rotation logs export to the artifact bundle.

elaine_ops: I can bundle: cert chains, ASN/IP ranges, private endpoint DNS entries, and a minimal runbook for the POC (activation, smoke tests, rollback). Will upload to secure share and provide access tokens. ETA: tomorrow noon.

ben_presales: Pricing draft assumptions: base routing-only POC (no BYO-KMS) = no infra uplift but needs reserved burst buffer = free trial credit; routing+BYO-KMS = +12% infra uplift due to private-link + support integration windows; routing+BYO-KMS+dedicated tenancy (per-tenant GPU pool) = +35% uplift and minimum 3-month commit. SLA add-on for 99.5% success/200ms P95 in a single AZ eu-west-1: add-on +22% on top of chosen option. I'll attach numbers after infra confirms capacity.

anna_sales: Could you put those as Option A/B/C with line items? FinCore legal wants a granular breakout for procurement.

carmen_infra: Capacity check: we can provide a 3-week reserved pool in eu-west-1 for the requested QPS assuming 2x concurrency headroom for spikes. Need advance notice to pre-warm KV caches and pre-load KV prefixes. Also must provision a dedicated network ACL for FinCore private-link. Example tenant-policy snippet (for ops): ```json
{
  "tenant_policy": {
    "region_pin": ["eu-west-1"],
    "allow_fallback": false,
    "private_endpoint": true,
    "byo_kms": true
  }
}
```
Note: allow_fallback=false disables GCP embedding variants.

dan_security: Important: document the quality/regression delta if we disable GCP fallbacks. For our small eval set with FinCore prompts, embedding recall dropped ~1.8% and latency 95th increased ~40ms on avg. We should include client sign-off checkbox for 'accept residency-related quality deltas'.

contracts-bot: contracts-bot: Request ID CNT-88421 created for "FinCore BYO-KMS DPA addendum". Assigned to @anna_sales and @lisa_legal (if needed). Deadline set to 7 business days.

anna_sales: Thanks. Two asks before I call them back: 1) formal artifact bundle ETA (ops), 2) priced options A/B/C with assumptions and line items (ben). If BYO-KMS requires private-link peering I need an ops-ready checklist for the client's infra team.

elaine_ops: I'll post S3 link to the bundle + a one-page checklist for customer network ops by EOD today. Link will be encrypted.

ben_presales: I'll produce a 1-page quote with itemized uplifts and a short SOW for the 3-week POC by tomorrow 10:00 UTC. Will highlight tradeoffs (cost vs fallback-induced quality).

anna_sales: Great. I'll schedule a call with FinCore's infra+legal for Thursday to walk them through options.

carmen_infra: Also flagging: if they insist on multi-AZ hard SLA we need cross-AZ capacity and active replication which pushes to Dedicated model. That changes commit terms (>=3 months). We'll note this in the quote.

anna_sales: Perfect. Thanks team :heart:
